![The conductor called "all aboard" in the middle of me taking this photo](media/rai.jpeg)

Rai Wandeler is a Junior Engineering major at Harvey Mudd College who has in their folly decided to
delve into the deep world of ~~magic~~ electronics. This is where this website comes into play. As a
part of the *Microprocessor Systems: Design & Applications* class, students progress and experience
is to be documented in a personal blog. This will outline my progress in the various labs and any
other stuff that I chose to write here over time.

Outside of this class I enjoy [theatre and various engineering projects](https://www.linkedin.com/in/raiwandeler/details/projects/). I love [repairing machines](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7471336971097939968/), photography, talking about larger topics, and making stuff.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
